data.name: Jamraan
data.gender_notes: Jamraan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jamraan is an Arabic name that signifies a person with a radiant and beautiful face, resembling the moon. The name Jamraan carries the meaning “Moon-like beauty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jamraan usually hope their child will grow to embody moon-like beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the moon is a symbol of guidance and illumination.
data.etymology: Jamraan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon-like beauty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jamraan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: جمران
in_arabic.meaning: جمران تعني الحصين أو القوي في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم جمران مشتق من الجذر العربي ج-م-ر، ويعني الحصين أو القوي. وقد ورد هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في سورة الجن، حيث يقول الله تعالى: 'وَمَن يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّهُ فِي النَّارِ جَمِيمًا' (الجن: 82). ويعتبر اسم جمران من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة والحصانة، مما يجعله اسمًا محبوبًا عند المسلمين.

in_urdu.name: جمران
in_urdu.meaning: جمران کا مطلب ہے مضبوط یا قوی
in_urdu.long_meaning: جمران نام عربی زبان کی جڑ ج-م-ر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مضبوط یا قوی۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر پاکستان اور بھارت میں۔ اس نام کی اہمیت اس کی معانی کی وجہ سے ہے، جو کہ قوت اور مضبوطی کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जम्रान
in_hindi.meaning: जम्रान का अर्थ है मजबूत या शक्तिशाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: जम्रान नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा के मूल ज-م-र से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है मजबूत या शक्तिशाली। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रचलित है, जहां यह नाम बच्चों को दिया जाता है जो मजबूत और साहसी हों। इस नाम का महत्व इसकी अर्थ की वजह से है, जो शक्ति और मजबूती का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: جمران
in_pashto.meaning: جمران معنی یې قوي یا مضبوط دی

in_english.name: Jamraan
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jamraan originates from the Arabic root ج-م-ر (j-m-r), which conveys meanings of strength, power, and fortification. This root is mentioned in the Quranic verse (Al-Jinn: 82), signifying a strong and enduring presence. Historically, the name Jamraan has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing resilience and fortitude. It is associated with positive personality traits such as courage, determination, and leadership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jamraan has a rich and captivating meaning in Arabic culture. It depicts a person with a lovely, radiant, and beautiful appearance that resembles the moon. In popular usage, the name is given to children with striking and elegant features. There is a sense of pride and wonder in knowing someone with such a distinguished name, as it evokes images of celestial beauty and majesty. The name carries a connotation of elegance, refinement, and high social status in Arabic societies.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Jamraan holds a deeper meaning that goes beyond physical beauty. It is a reminder of the inner light and divine presence that exists within every individual, just as the moon illuminates the night sky. The name is an invitation to look past the superficial and recognize the inner beauty and worth of each person.
